title: Dirty Talk
summary:
Dirty Talk
Producers, traders, brokers, buyers, regulators and financiers gathered this June in Houston at Platts 5 th annual Bunker & Residual Fuel Oil Conference to hear other industry players' views of what the future holds for the "bottom of the barrel" oils. All of the presentations outlined the general notion that the fuel oil industry grapples with fast- changing developments such as heavier crude slates, refinery upgrades, decline in consumption by the electricity and manufacturing industries, and fuel oil quality modifications reflecting increasing environmental concerns. To give some perspective on the direction marine fuel regulations are headed, Stefka Ilieva, a fuel oil analyst and editor of Poten's monthly publication Fuel Oil in World Markets , was invited as a panel speaker to share her views on the impact of the International Maritime Organization's (IMO) bunker fuel standards on bunker production as well as possible solutions.
